title: Large, repeated and mixed input projections of authored bases (generated)
description: 66 projections stored as recipes (the bytes are assembled, never embedded): one base at the head, middle or tail of 64 KiB, 256 KiB or 1 MiB of credential-free filler; one base repeated at three positions; two distinct bases of one family; two bases of two families. Eight bases, 66 correlated inputs. Synthetic: every value is a fake word run padded with zeros, in the alphabet and at the length of the family's current contract, and was never issued. None was tested against any service.
